name: Pizza Parlor
notes: ChowNow, the restaurant's own ordering platform, read from its REST API with probe/extract_chownow.js. The menu lives at a versioned path — /api/restaurant/1708/menu returns an empty object, while /api/restaurant/1708/menu/<next_available_time> returns the catalog, and that stamp comes from /api/restaurant/1708. Prices are plain dollar numbers; nothing was computed. The restaurant endpoint gives the address as S. O St and Mc Cain Blvd, Building 614, Coronado — the Naval Base Coronado location, matching the record's 614 S O St, 92135. The "Popular Items" carousel was dropped as it repeats dishes from their real sections. Captured by the coordinator session 2026-08-31.
